first_responses.discovery:
Bounded independent discovery — template-project, 2026-10-19

Baseline and independence

Baseline HEAD: 1099ddc6568af5bb2e4a1d080dfc315653cbff58. This was a read-only discovery assignment. No repository file, permission, external service or agent was changed. The sole output is this disposable result file.

First judgment, preserved before responding to the parent's proposed edits: the existing owners already state most of the requested capabilities unusually explicitly. Positive examples, revisable premises, real comparisons, method adaptation and shared-blind-spot challenges are present. The likely high-value work is to make normal consumers enact those capabilities, rather than create another general learning obligation. The strongest initially observed affordance gap was the holistic-evaluation template's weak connection between a claimed review scope and the evidence actually inspected.

This was not a blind review of the parent plan. The first search returned headings and excerpts from that plan. Later, the parent sent its candidate direction, and I then read the complete plan. The first judgment above was sent to the parent before examining that candidate further. Parent edits began during this review; the experience and causal-analysis citations below were checked against git show HEAD so they refer to the baseline, not the parent's revisions.

Actual context and inputs

I received the owner's principles through the parent's faithful English account, not the full original private conversation. I read the supplied AGENTS.md instructions, docs/README.md task-context and language rules, relevant governance boundaries, development outcomes/verification/experience/causal-analysis sections, autonomous direction-review/work-selection/method-learning sections, execution independence and consumer routes, the research guide, the project-operation guide through its research-and-writing example, and the verification, holistic-evaluation, independent-review, execution-plan and handoff templates. I also inspected data-analysis measurement calibration, the engineering-judgment target's status and comparison method, and the October 10 adoption record. The engineering-judgment document is status: target, implementation: not_started; I did not treat it as current adopted behavior. I did not read the new case packet or trial outputs, run a consumer experiment, inspect private source-project artifacts, or research external systems theory.

Finding 1 — make the completion consumer expose what its review can actually establish

Supported gap: templates/holistic-evaluation.md sections "Claim and completion layer", "Independence" and "Evidence inventory" (baseline lines 11–30) name a claim, revision, independent context and evidence limits, but do not ask what material was supplied versus inspected, the scope of that inspection, or whether that scope can establish the particular verdict. Its six dimensions can therefore receive apparently complete findings while an evaluator inspected only a report, summary or edited excerpt. This is an affordance in the template, not evidence that a particular past reviewer actually failed.

The normative behavior is substantially already present. docs/contracts/development-discipline.md § "Verify promised and observed behavior in both directions" requires evidence at the affected boundary, the real consumer's inputs, and the smallest credible evidence for each claim (baseline lines 150–205). docs/contracts/agent-execution-discipline.md § "Independence is evidence, not a label" distinguishes context from evidence and requires actual supplied material (161–184). docs/guides/research.md § "Verification" already distinguishes a standards reviewer from a fresh reader and says their different inputs test different claims (202–206). A new universal review rule would duplicate these owners.

Useful capability to enable: a reviewer can actively choose the correct object and scope for a valuable judgment. Source fidelity can need original records; whole-artifact coherence can need the whole integrated artifact; reader usefulness can need only the published consumer view. An evaluator should be able to say a local claim passed while obtaining the additional material needed for the broader claim, rather than issuing a ritual whole-result pass or stopping with a generic limitation.

Smallest plausible intervention: put a conditional inspected-scope/claim-fit cue in the existing completion and independent-review consumers, or a compact example beside them. Keep the evidence inventory's existing limitations field; avoid a second universal checklist. Exercise a packet where the same excerpt supports a local correctness claim but fails to establish article-wide coherence, then observe whether the consumer acquires and judges the right artifact. The parent should retain a baseline success if the existing prompt already accomplishes this.

Countercase: a typo fix with unchanged semantics should not require rereading the entire research corpus or commissioning a complete fresh article review. The cue must scale to the claim, not expand every review's scope.

Finding 2 — demonstrate a growth decision through changed work, not one more abstract instruction

Supported gap: the existing worked consumer example in docs/guides/project-operation.md § "Worked example: a research and writing effort across sessions" is a table of situations and recommended responses (257–290). The central value-mismatch row says to revisit the question and approach when local tasks pass but the reader learns little (279), and the discovery row says a surprising theme can be explored (280). Neither shows the actual change in question, comparison, explanation or deliverable. A consumer can restate the right response without exercising the creative judgment the owner wants. This is a missing worked affordance and verification opportunity; it is not an absence of permission to create or evidence of a general inability.

Existing text already resolves the normative question. docs/guides/research.md § "Develop research into worthwhile content" explicitly requires a worthwhile premise, positive examples, external material changing the question or form, useful unresolved tension, whole-artifact reading, and possible abandonment of a first draft (151–177). docs/contracts/autonomous-operation-discipline.md § "Learning includes exploration and revision of the operating method" permits discovery before classification, preserves successful but cumbersome arrangements, supports method change, and calls for new standards from external and positive material (298–338). Its § "Work selection compares value before committing effort" already rejects letting small, easy or countable tasks define the candidates (239–256). Development's § "Experience changes the next matching action" requires an actual subsequent task using the change through its ordinary entrypoint (258–287). Adding the same obligations again would provide little new capability.

Useful capability to enable: use a source, good example or owner correction to discover a better question and then produce a more useful artifact; reuse the mechanism in the next task while preserving what made the previous work valuable. This is positive growth, not only more accurate defect classification.

Smallest plausible intervention: replace or extend one row of the existing worked example with a compact concrete transformation, or use the parent's bounded consumer trial as that demonstration. Give actual small source-shaped material, ask for an audience-useful artifact, and inspect the resulting question and explanation. Compare with the initial artifact under the same intended use. Show which useful distinction was gained and which useful property was preserved. Include an occasion where keeping the initial form is the right judgment. A new general paragraph about judgment versus effort is worthwhile only if consumers demonstrably choose a better action through it, or if it creates a missing retrieval cue for an already-required behavior.

Countercase: when a straightforward question is already useful and evidence supports its explanation, forcing reframing or novel form wastes time and may destroy a clear answer. Successful repetition should be allowed to accelerate; a need for novelty is not a growth mechanism.

Challenge to the proposed direction

The parent plan's intended outcome is sound, but I would not characterize positive learning, preservation of responsibilities or revisable confidence as missing doctrine. In particular, autonomous operation already says to inspect responsibilities and contribution before removing cumbersome structures (309–321), and data-analysis § "Measures support fallible judgment and remain open to correction" already calibrates against valuable acceptable and unfamiliar cases and investigates reassuring zeros (138–161). The evidence record should show why a new clause improves a decision beyond these existing instructions. If baseline and revised consumers both succeed, report that result and prefer a clearer consumer route or worked artifact over growing the normative layer.

I found two defensible improvement opportunities at consumer and demonstration surfaces. I do not have enough behavioral evidence to assert a third missing rule. No bounded instruction exercise can establish long-term autonomous growth, weaker-executor performance, real audience response, or calibration of intelligence; these remain outside this discovery result.
first_responses.baseline:
FIRST ANSWER

A. Pause the proposed throughput expansion. Use the existing 20-hour budget for a small explanation trial; reopen the review's outline exclusion and replace retelling-only release criteria with accurate explanation plus demonstrated reader discrimination. Bring direction review forward because observed reader outcomes contradict the claimed progress. Doubling output and adding confidence retain the mechanism that excludes the needed distinction; the trade-off is fewer summaries while testing usefulness.

Reader explanation:
“Shade changed pavement temperature much more than measured air temperature at Site 1 that afternoon: pavement was 49°C in sun and 31°C in shade, an 18°C difference; air at 1.5 metres was 33°C and 32°C, a 1°C difference. These are different measurements. Site 2 lacks a matched shade observation, so it cannot provide the same comparison. These observations do not measure ventilation or establish comfort: there is no comfort survey or humidity observation. They support a local comparison, not a rule for every place.”

Change the operating decision if reader trials demonstrate reliable understanding and the remaining constraint is access to examples, making throughput valuable, or if the new explanation fails and another form performs better. Preserve failed trials; confidence labels alone would not establish that change.

B. Before deletion, the public main text is:
“The neighborhood unanimously welcomed the exhibition. At a meeting, two residents supported it and three asked to postpone it. The minutes do not say how other residents felt.”

After deleting editorNotes, the public main text is:
“The neighborhood unanimously welcomed the exhibition. At a meeting, two residents supported it and three asked to postpone it. The minutes do not say how other residents felt.”

The proposal leaves the public contradiction intact because editorNotes never enters that rendering. Smallest correction: retain the source note and replace the lead with “Residents at a meeting expressed different views about the proposed exhibition.” Keep the body unchanged. The resulting lead and body describe the recorded disagreement without treating postponement as opposition or extrapolating to the neighborhood.

The reviewers' agreement establishes their shared recommendation about the full record under a schema-oriented question. It supplies no evidence that the proposed deletion changes public understanding. The before/after rendering directly refutes that causal claim.

C. Replacement run instruction:
“Use one dispatcher and shared startup. At each wake read the live charter, recorded state, applicable rules, and due reviews. Use the issuer's declared schedule zone; missing time policy blocks outbound release pending resolution. From 20:00 inclusive until 08:00 exclusive, gate every publication and notification, including retries. Within the existing resource ceiling, investigate better questions and try bounded research/evaluation improvements. Preserve questions, attempts, useful findings, negative results, evidence, and recoverable next steps. Preserve required independent review and halt/recovery responsibilities. At 08:00 load those results and resume currently authorized publishing work, checking current authority and release conditions. Never amend the charter.”

Static verification: this retains both nighttime silence and active investigation; dormancy retained only silence. Boundary walkthrough: at 20:00 and 07:59 outbound effects are blocked while inquiry remains authorized; at 08:00 publishing becomes eligible and saved findings remain available. The migration's runtime acceptance must observe the actual outbound boundary and preserved inquiry artifacts across restart within budget. No runtime was supplied or exercised.

D. New opening:
“‘We borrowed a joke,’ says one walker; newcomers thought they were preserving an ancient name. An ordinary alley became ‘Dragon Bridge’ in a walking club's joke, then appeared literally on a visitor's map. Who gives such routes their meaning? These archive fragments follow people naming places, testing passage, and disputing which names deserve to last. An accessibility group's dated, tested curb-free paths offer another kind of authority. A city cartographer describes unofficial names entering municipal maps, even while residents disagree over whose name should prevail.”

Proposed structure:
1. A joke travels: Dragon Bridge and the change from shared joke to apparent history.
2. A route earns trust: tested curb-free paths, dates, and the limits of an observation.
3. A name becomes official: municipal adoption and unresolved claims to naming.

Retain the earlier sentence's human voice, surprise, and attention to residents. This sacrifices a single, compact explanation based on official neglect; the supplied observations support several relationships between residents, readers, and institutions.

E. Dispatch four bounded assignments using stable ready-manifest positions: worker 1 gets pages 1–75; worker 2, 76–150; worker 3, 151–225; worker 4, 226–300. Record disjoint output ownership in the existing work register. Carry the accepted mapping, immutable input identities, existing checks and recovery rules, fixed budget, and integration owner into each assignment. Workers return outputs, identity-linked verification, and failures; the integration owner checks complete coverage, collisions, and combined results. Reuse checks whose stated validity holds.

Invalidate this acceleration if independence fails, inputs/dependencies change, budget contention appears, or recovery evidence contradicts the established rules. These are dispatch instructions for the fictional case; no workers were launched.

F. Use the calibration example when comparing predicted choices with actual owner decisions.

Verified by direct comparison: only “calibartion” became “calibration”; meaning and remaining text are unchanged.

CONTEXT / READING AUDIT

Received: system/developer instructions, tool and skill catalogs, environment metadata, the human-supplied live-workspace AGENTS.md injected into the prompt, and the parent's bounded assignment. I used no separate personal context or other trial verdicts.

Heading scans located sections. Some tool output was truncated; critical sections were reread. All six answers use supplied fictional facts and direct reasoning. No external calls, runtime execution, independent audience tests, or live migration occurred. Only this response file was written.

Resume scaling when reader trials on familiar and unfamiliar cases demonstrate these distinctions under the revised standard. Continued misunderstanding would instead require revising the explanation, evidence or evaluation task.

D. Opening:
“We borrowed a joke,” says one walker; newcomers thought we were preserving an ancient name. A walking club called an ordinary alley “Dragon Bridge”; a visitor’s map later took the joke literally. first_responses.integration_review:
Independent integration review — first judgment, 2026-10-19

Verdict

PASS for the bounded documentation integration reviewed here. I found no
supported material defect requiring a change before this integration can close.
The consumer observations show useful baseline behavior and useful revised
behavior, with no consequential regression apparent in the six supplied cases.
They do not establish comparative improvement, long-term learning, or an effect
for a weaker executor. Those are separate, unproved claims.

This is my first supported judgment. I sent its substance to the parent before
reading the newly appearing trials archive. No clarification, repair proposal,
executor defense, or desired verdict was requested or received after it. Reading
the archive did not change the judgment.

Actual context and independence

I am a separately dispatched Codex review context that did not produce this
proposal, its implementation, or either consumer response. I received the common
system/developer harness, tool and skill catalogs, environment and injected
workspace AGENTS.md, and the parent's bounded assignment. The assignment supplied
an English account of the owner's purposes, scope, candidate concerns, reported
check results, successful baseline result and pending revised result. A later
factual message supplied the location of the completed revised first response.

I did not receive or inspect the full original private conversation or source
project. The owner account is therefore attributed to the parent, not claimed
as my independent reconstruction. I read the current plan and evidence, which
contain implementation rationale and discovery judgments, as part of the
requested review. This is independent production and judgment, not blind or
independently acquired source evidence. The discovery's judgment in the archive
was read only after I had sent my own supported verdict. No external calls or
agents were used. My sole write is this result file.

Artifact and inspected scope

Baseline: HEAD 1099ddc6568af5bb2e4a1d080dfc315653cbff58. I inspected the actual
working-tree diff for all twelve tracked changed files, plus the new plan,
evidence and case packet. The tracked changes cover docs/README.md; development
and autonomous-operation contracts; Grill, research, project-operation,
information-access and onboarding guides; charter, holistic-evaluation and
independent-review templates; and the fixture clock in test_check_docs.py.
The information-access and onboarding changes are reconciliation dates only.

For interaction and authority I read the task-context rule, relevant governance
boundaries, development's coherent-end-state, outcomes, judgment, verification,
experience and causal-analysis sections, execution risk/independence/coordination/
delegation rules, autonomous work-selection and method-adaptation sections,
surrounding research and operating guidance, and the relevant review templates.
I read docs-policy.toml before assessing the enforcement claim and checked the
architecture's unconfigured template state. Critical diff and context sections
were reopened after broad tool output was truncated.

I read both complete raw consumer responses and their reading audits from the
named disposable result files, then inspected the new trials JSON's metadata,
hashes, dispatches, consumer response records and artifact-check claims. The
large discovery string was only partially displayed; no conclusion here relies
on treating it as a complete independent inspection. I did not inspect a live
product, rendered source-project pages, scheduler, original research archive or
the frozen instruction directories themselves. The revised manifest's hashes
for the changed normative owners and guide/template instruction surfaces match
the live file hashes I inspected. The final prose evidence/plan reconciliation
was still underway, as declared in the assignment.

Why the integration passes

1. Judgment and effort are distinguished at the responsible owners. The new
   development section triggers on recurring correction or disappointing value,
   identifies whether the affected question, candidate set, standard, evidence
   or execution is responsible, and routes into existing comparisons and reuse.
   It specifically distinguishes a missed observation from an observed finding
   discounted by a release or selection rule. The observation method and standard
   also remain revisable. These mechanisms address the supplied purpose without
   requiring a performance of doubt or more reviewers.

2. The observations can change action. Claim-specific scope is owned in
   verification and projected into the completion and independent-review
   consumers. A source record and public projection can establish different
   properties. This makes the inspection boundary explicit without declaring
   that independent agreement alone supplies missing evidence. The before/after
   preservation rule includes positive distinctions and exploration duties.

3. Positive creation remains available. The research example actually changes
   a question and opening from a flower inventory to a temporal explanation,
   explains retained species information and sacrificed catalog coverage, and
   retains a legitimate catalog countercase. Constructive owner feedback is
   treated as a possible source of new questions and methods. This is a useful
   worked affordance; its existence is not proof that consumers improve.

4. Authority and ordinary work retain their boundaries. The new text uses
   existing records and checkpoints, preserves review independence and issuer
   authority, and expressly permits sound work to accelerate. There is no new
   standing schedule, form, scoring system, publication permission or additional
   review tier. The source-project machinery and private material are not copied.
   I found no obligation that requires reopening the whole project on a routine
   correction or continuing reflection past a bounded task's completion.

Independent assessment of actual consumer choices

Both consumers complete A usefully: they refuse blind volume amplification,
identify the release standard's exclusion of an already observed distinction,
produce a correct local heat explanation, and identify evidence for revising
their decision. Both compute B's unchanged public projection and correct the
overstated lead while retaining the body and editorial evidence. Both preserve
C's nighttime inquiry duty as well as publication silence and disclose that
runtime was not exercised. Both produce D's coherent opening and structure
around changing meaning, tested access and contested naming, retaining the
borrowed-joke voice while abandoning the single neglect explanation. Both give
E concrete four-worker assignments with disjoint ownership and invalidation
conditions, and both perform F directly.

The revised answer is not evidence of a newly acquired general capability: the
baseline already demonstrated these choices. Differences in wording, extra
boundary details or concision do not isolate an instructional effect. Reading
audits differ: the baseline reports reading the research guide; the revised
consumer does not. The added garden example and changed review templates were
not themselves demonstrated as causal contributors by this trial. This limits
the comparison, rather than invalidating either useful artifact. No audience
trial, actual dispatch, scheduler migration or repeated autonomous operation
occurred, so none can be certified from these outputs.

Checks and remaining limits

I independently ran git diff --check against the stated baseline; it passed.
I inspected the fixture's sole change from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-19 and found no
test or production-checker relaxation in the diff. The 122 passing tests and
normal/strict checker passes remain parent-reported and recorded evidence; I
did not rerun them under this read-only assignment. Policy declares adopted/full
enforcement, whose structural checks cannot establish creative judgment.

I found no supported evidence that the source observations or owner account are
false, but did not independently reproduce them or verify the Meadows reference.
I did not infer improvement from text volume or structural checks. The parent's
declared pending evidence reconciliation and final verification are known closure
work, not an additional discovered finding. Any later substantive instruction
change falls outside this first review. No new human decision is identified by
this review; longer-term effectiveness remains an operational hypothesis.
